subtitle: Spell words, ride the leaves
description:
Glideleaf is a word game about a small flying squirrel in an autumn birch wood. Leaves are falling all around her, and each one carries a letter. Drag your finger through nearby leaves to spell a word, then let go. She glides along your word and lands on its last letter.

The leaves never stop falling, so your words are also your way up. Each letter has to be within gliding reach of the one before it, which means you are not just finding words, you are finding words that climb. Long words carry her higher. If her leaf drifts all the way down to the leaf pile, she uses up an acorn. Three landings and the run is over.

Start your next word on the leaf where you landed to build a chain and multiply your points. Gold leaves double a letter. Later on, wet leaves slide past the others and brittle leaves crumble soon after you land on them. Acorn leaves win back a life. The fall gets faster every minute, so every run turns into a race against the ground.

Painted in a warm picture-book style, with a word list of tens of thousands of words built in. Short runs, one-finger controls and a best score to beat. Plays fully offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Leaves are falling and every one carries a letter. Spell words through them to glide a little flying squirrel upward before she reaches the ground.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Drag from a leaf near the squirrel through nearby leaves to spell a word of 3 or more letters, then lift your finger so she glides along it. The game ends after she falls into the leaf pile three times.
